results.content: President Donald Trump’s approval rating has fallen to 33 percent in the latest Economist/YouGov poll, marking his lowest approval in YouGov tracking across both his first and second terms. The survey, conducted August 7–10, 2026, found that 62 percent of Americans disapprove of his job performance, giving Trump a net approval rating of -29, also the lowest he has ever recorded. [...] The political implications are evident in congressional preference. Democrats now lead Republicans 46 to 40 percent among registered voters for the 2026 House elections, the largest Democratic advantage in any Economist/YouGov poll since February 2026.
